calibration_selection.selection_metric: minimum Brier score, then log loss, subject to retaining at least 99% of raw behavioural average precision

behavioural_probability.role: v0.3 release champion and primary ranking signal

decision_policy_semantics.approve: risk is below the investigator review threshold
decision_policy_semantics.decline: offline high-risk recommendation only; no automated customer action is performed

explanations.baseline: per-feature median over legitimate development rows

feature_store.label_exposure_policy: suspicious-neighbour label propagation is excluded because PaySim has no fraud-confirmation timestamp

model_artifact.checksum_policy: local-only because non-canonical joblib byte serialization can change while predictions and semantic metrics remain equal

calibration_selection.purpose: select calibration method without future data

development.purpose: fit base classifier, anomaly, and graph models
